title: js2264/plexembler pipeline - params.libraries schema
description: The pooled libraries (--libraries): one row per pair of FASTQ files of a library made from a pool of species; the rows of a library are its runs. A relative path is read from the samplesheet's folder, so file paths are strings here and the pipeline checks that they exist (docs/usage.md).

library.errorMessage: A library's ID: letters, digits, _, . and -, starting with a letter or a digit

pool.errorMessage: A pool's ID: a letter, then letters, digits and hyphens; a pool of the species samplesheet

type.errorMessage: A library's type: hic, wgs or rnaseq

fastq_1.errorMessage: The first reads of the pairs: a gzipped FASTQ file (.fastq.gz, .fq.gz), without spaces in its path

fastq_2.errorMessage: The second reads of the pairs: a gzipped FASTQ file (.fastq.gz, .fq.gz), without spaces in its path

condition.errorMessage: An RNA-seq library's condition: letters, digits, _, . and -

replicate.errorMessage: An RNA-seq library's replicate: a whole number, 1 or more

enzymes.errorMessage: A Hi-C library's restriction enzymes, comma-separated, as Biopython names them (DpnII,HinfI); none for a library made without one (Micro-C)
